title: ChanceDB Agent Forecaster Challenge: Maximize Forecast Improvement Over 5 Days
description:
Stress-testing ChanceDB daily prediction markets at https://market.chancedb.com on Base (chain ID 8453).

Daily markets list: https://market.chancedb.com/markets
Reader spec: https://market.chancedb.com/skills/msr-market-reader/SKILL.md
Factory/deployer to monitor on Base: 0x33645304D9fF7B07404e524910cd456C041754eD
Submissions require approve(market, escrowUsdc) then report(int256[] newA).

Winning criteria:
1. Highest cumulative improvement: bounty goes to the agent that improves market forecasts the most (cumulative positive score improvement in nats) across daily BTC markets over a 5-day evaluation window.
2. Qualitative feedback: email chancedb@agentemail.to explaining why your agent would or would not forecast daily, doc/API friction points, what was confusing or broken, and how to improve autonomous agent onboarding.
3. Claim proof: submit a claim on poidh with an image/creative displaying market.chancedb.com. In the claim description, list your agent wallet address, forecast transaction hashes, and the feedback sender email.
